sheet: data/gold/pd_e2e_pilot_blind.csv (owner-reviewed, copied into the human-owned gold folder by the owner on 2026-10-10; the interim sheet was restored to the blank version)
origin: All annotation rows carry annotator_id = chatgpt_research_prefill: the rows were produced by an LLM research tool as a prefill.
human_review: The owner states they reviewed every row (2026-10-10). This is a self-attestation; the file itself records no per-row edits.
